#42
let n = int(input())
var items = []
var i = 0
var sum = 0
while i < n {
  let old = items
  items = push(i, items)
  sum += len(old)
  i += 1
}
print("RESULT n=${len(items)} first=${items[0]} last=${items[n - 1]} sum=${sum}")
